rotation: Cupboard: build panels and a shelf family; change stock, width and count; inspect joints; save/reopen.
Rounded panel or sign: outer corners and opening; sketch and solid fillets; inspect shaded edges; undo/cancel/reopen.
Divided tray: select a physical copy, change count and clearance, suppress/restore and continue editing.
Fitted joints: change stock, height and finger count; swap targets/tools; inspect fit and downstream effects.
Recovery and viewport: wrong face, Escape, undo/redo, live dialog preview, camera changes and smaller viewport; finish a useful object.
